name: PLSC 1300
title: Introduction to Soil Science
description: Physical and chemical properties of soils; nature and use of fertilizer and liming materials; management of soils for crop production including soil testing, tillage, fertilization practices, and conservation practices. Taught with SAPL 300. Formerly offered as SPSS 1300.
requirement_description: Not open to students who have passed PLSC 2120.
